evidence_classes.DECODED DATA: ROM tables/records decoded by a parser
evidence_classes.BYTE-VERIFIED ASSEMBLY: routine bytes compared literally and disassembled by hand
evidence_classes.SOURCE-TRACED BEHAVIOR: behavior read from the disassembly, not executed
evidence_classes.CONTROLLED ROUTINE RESULT: original routine executed on a Z80 core with explicit RAM
evidence_classes.EMULATED ORIGINAL FRAME: whole original game run in the approximate SMS harness

probe_coordinate_fixture.rule: probeX = anchorX (BC=0); probeY = anchorY + (-26 | -16) + 18, negative -> 0; column = probeX >> 5, row = probeY >> 5 (32x32 layout cells)

thz1.model: collect iff block(probe cell) in $40..$45, presence[block][quadrant(probe)] != 0; quadrant = ((probeX>>4)&1) + 2*((probeY>>4)&1)

thz2.model: collect iff block(probe cell) in $40..$45, presence[block][quadrant(probe)] != 0; quadrant = ((probeX>>4)&1) + 2*((probeY>>4)&1)

thz3.model: collect iff block(probe cell) in $40..$45, presence[block][quadrant(probe)] != 0; quadrant = ((probeX>>4)&1) + 2*((probeY>>4)&1)

region_fixture.edges: all four edges inclusive at integer-pixel resolution; the fractional position bytes (+$10, +$13) are not used

direction_fixture.conclusion: the routine reads only +$07 bit 0, X, Y (and +$22 for type $1A): velocity direction, requested state and contact flags do not matter; 'from below' or 'from the side' collects exactly when the single probe point lies in the quadrant

effects_fixture.side_effects: BCD +1 on $D29A (carry past $99 runs $3104 + $178F), block write to the layout cell (D354), tile redraw $23F9, type $03 effect via $5E9C at the probe point (D35C/D35E = probeX, probeY), sound $BF, $3138

other_types_fixture.note: type $1D: block -> $46 and +10 rings; type $1A: needs +$22 bit 1, sets X speed $0700 and requests state $10; type $14: depth correction path. Semantic names are UNRESOLVED; they are listed only because they share the probe.

timer_fixture.routine: $64FA with the player slot, bank $0C re-paged before each call (as $361D does)
timer_fixture.rule: records load +$07 = duration; every update without a reload does DEC (IX+7) at $6510; FF 05 / frame-selector routines may set +$07 themselves; +$07 bit 0 is therefore the parity of the remaining animation ticks, not a posture flag

emulated_play.method: THZ1 booted in tools/sms_frame_harness.py, 6000 frames of seeded pseudo-random pad input (RIGHT, DOWN+RIGHT, LEFT, jump), PC hook at $753E with IX=$D500

emulated_forced_states.method: state requested every frame (twist on a THZ1 twist block, others near the start); counts only calls whose current state equals the forced one
